title: Three campers frozen and abducted at a lake

tellings.quote: And this one um this one event that I got the record of, there were three guys camping at a lake and they it was nighttime.

plain: Three men camping at a lake at night were frozen in place and abducted, according to a record of the event that Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says he got hold of among classified study materials. Buchanan tells it on the show from that record, not as a witness, and gives no place or date.
